name: sql-assistant
description: SQL Assistant — schema-aware read-only and Change Request SQL generator with an offline self-training NLU, centralized learning, an Admin Query Library, schema CASE/DECODE, cross-device schema synchronization (Pull Schema from GitHub with hidden repository configuration and a Secret Vault pull card), a CENTRAL Admin Password (one encrypted record for all devices, Save and Reset to default), a short cross-device administrator message in the navbar, CENTRAL repository access through a trusted repository access service that holds the GitHub PAT as a GitHub Actions secret (no token on any device), a PUBLISHED copy of the repository data that devices read without any GitHub credential, and an optional AI/LLM Model.
